name: Sarah Jenkins
comment: We integrated this full-stack MEVN setup into our platform overhaul and user engagement jumped by 40% in the first week. The clean glassmorphic aesthetic speaks volumes.

name: Alex Rivers
comment: Clean, lightning-fast Vue 3 and Express REST API setup. Absolutely love the subtle Digital Lavender glassmorphism execution here!

name: Elena Rostova
comment: The native MongoDB driver connection and live search watcher made browsing feedback entries effortless. Great responsive grid layout.

name: Marcus Vance
comment: Zero heavy frontend dependencies—just pure Vue 3 CDN, fetch Promises, and Express middleware working together smoothly.

name: Priya Nair
comment: The dark slate background with soft lavender glow reduces eye strain while keeping the star ratings and badges easy to scan.

name: David Kim
comment: Really helpful starter project for understanding how GET, POST, and PUT routes communicate between Vue and Express.
